objective: Add Kimi for Coding (global) as the first and only model provider of the HolyAgent Pi integration: the route table, the readiness and catalog checks, the provider package selection and its docs, in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-provider (branch release/0.3.0/feat/kimi-provider).
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-provider and run every command there; node_modules is installed. Gates: bunx --no-install mise run verify and bunx --no-install mise run build.

The full requirements of this change are in /home/user/holyagent-notes/intent-kimi-provider.txt (the Intent); read it first and treat its requirements and 'Decided' entries as binding. Also read AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, docs/pi/providers.md, docs/pi/configuration.md, docs/pi/caching-and-subagents.md, docs/pi/installation.md, packages/runtime/src/config/{schema,load,packages}.ts (the config with its pi section and the package list it enables), packages/integrations/pi/src/*, and the pi package probes in /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-deps.md and /home/user/holyagent-notes/pi-probe/ (README of pi-provider-kimi-code and pi-coding-agent under pi-probe/readmes/). Do not run the pi binary.

Build: (1) one mapping module (for example packages/runtime/src/pi/provider.ts or under config/) from route-table role and effort to provider/id and thinking level, the only place provider choice lives; (2) the Kimi route table as config.json defaults in the pi section, every one of the eighteen specialist roles plus the root mapped to a model and thinking level with a one-line reason each, exactly as the Intent's 'Decided routing' entry says (root kimi-coding k3.1 pro at high, max selectable; the listed specialists on the kimi-for-coding model at max or high, never low; Worker.visual and Reviewer.visual on k3.1 pro at low), decoded with Effect Schema and overridable per role; use the provider id and model ids the probes and the pi-provider-kimi-code README give, and where a fact is not in those files say so in the report rather than guessing; (3) a readiness check that runs `pi auth check --provider <id> --json` through an injected command runner and maps exit 0 to ready, 1 to not_ready (a blocker carrying the login fix, /login kimi-coding or KIMI_API_KEY) and 2 to invalid, never replacing the provider; (4) a catalog check that validates the mapped model ids against the output of `pi --list-models` (parse its format from the probe notes or pi-coding-agent README; use a synthesized fixture), reporting unknown ids as a blocker; (5) the provider environment the launcher will set on Pi processes (KIMI_CODE_REGION=global) exported from the mapping; (6) provider selection in config: selecting kimi-for-coding enables pi-provider-kimi-code in the package list from packages.ts, pinned at its current release line, and deselecting it disables it; no other provider is implemented or documented as supported; (7) docs/pi/providers.md gains the Kimi for Coding facts the integration relies on: provider id, login, region and host, model ids, thinking levels and the route-table mapping with reasons, and the cache rule that each session keeps one model and effort.

Out of scope: launching processes (the specialist launcher change uses these functions), the web tools (tool-surface change), setup and doctor, cache-rate reporting from provider usage. Name what they need in the report.
constraints: Unit tests and synthesized fixtures only; no live pi or Kimi runs, no network calls.
HolyAgent never calls provider URLs, never reads auth.json, and never uses pi auth print-api-key or print-bearer-token.

Dependencies change only through the updater (mise run deps:update); if pinning pi-provider-kimi-code needs a package.json or bun.lock change, add it the way the existing pi packages in packages.ts are handled and say how.
Keep the Claude generated output unchanged.
Make no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; report changed paths.
Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md (Effect, Schema with onExcessProperty error, JSDoc, Bun APIs).
Report in under 450 words; start each evidence line with the exact criterion text (no backticks), a colon, then the support; put long logs in a file outside the repository.

criteria.text: One mapping module is the only place provider choice lives, and it maps every role and the root as the Intent's decided routing says, with tests
The route table lives in config defaults, decodes with Effect Schema, and can be overridden per role, with tests including an invalid override
The readiness check maps exit 0, 1 and 2 to ready, not_ready with the login fix, and invalid, without replacing the provider, with tests
The catalog check rejects model ids missing from the pi --list-models output, with fixture tests
Selecting the provider enables pi-provider-kimi-code and deselecting it disables it, and no other provider is offered
docs/pi/providers.md states the provider id, login, region and host, model ids, thinking levels and the route table with reasons
No provider URL, auth.json read or print-api-key or print-bearer-token use anywhere in the change
bunx --no-install mise run verify exits 0 and mise run build leaves generated output in sync
